method: Ordinary visible Chrome retrieval for HTML; direct download of publicly linked PDF guides. URL/title checked explicitly. No manuscript uploaded to any external preflight service.
source_priority: Journal-specific author guidelines take priority over the linked legacy generic upload guide. Accessibility guidance is advisory where it says if possible. The linked ISCB policy is dated 3 April 2025 and uses stronger drafting wording than the OUP summary.
raw_capture_note: Full third-party pages/PDFs are retained in local scratch only; the report paraphrases requirements and links original sources.
